method: Prompt-centered paraphrase of repeated user feedback; no raw transcript, credentials, or student records.

themes.promptPattern: Resume from the indexed handoff and prior user intent without dumping earlier sessions or redoing settled work.
themes.rootCause: Dated narrative files can be mistaken for the current state, and a shallow index can pass stale or false evidence.
themes.canary: Swap an in-progress plan into latestCompletedEvidence, or use an impossible calendar date.

themes.promptPattern: Repeated corrections should change agent runtime guidance and verification, including .codex and .agents, beyond a task-level summary.
themes.rootCause: No independent theme inventory or omission check carried user feedback into the next session.
themes.canary: Remove one required feedback theme and require coverage validation to fail.

themes.promptPattern: Use Chrome DevTools native text and network tools actively, avoiding repeated screenshot exploration and verifying the actual browser session.
themes.rootCause: MCP registration and a local handshake can be mistaken for callable tools in the current Codex session.
themes.canary: Report registered MCP as session-connected when native tools are absent.

themes.promptPattern: Find bounded academy site and app facts without repeatedly exploring the UI or spending tokens on route discovery.
themes.rootCause: Page shells and route names were promoted to student-level read contracts without verified joins or effect semantics.
themes.canary: Treat a menu HTTP 200 or a legacy GET route as a verified student read.

themes.promptPattern: Build new project and runtime engineering with TypeScript and Bun, keeping Python only for existing required gates or unique verified readers.
themes.rootCause: Convenience scripts can multiply runtimes and obscure the one approved read path.
themes.canary: Add a new convenience Python discovery helper for a routine harness task.

themes.promptPattern: Keep teacher-confirmed lesson dates and homework facts through compaction and do not ask for the same answer again.
themes.rootCause: Unverified backend occurrence binding can accidentally downgrade a teacher's confirmed date.
themes.canary: Delete the 2026-09-23 teacher-confirmed prior lesson date from pilot scope.

themes.promptPattern: Research a development-environment rubric, evaluate independently, optimize validated findings, and carry approval across compaction.
themes.rootCause: An implicit subphase can disappear from the current-state index even while agents are working.
themes.canary: Remove I1 from the active subphase or point its prerequisite at an unconsolidated E1 artifact.
